Name: Buy Auto Petter
Author: RancherOfSlimes
Description:
[b]This mod will add an Auto-Petter to Marnie's shop after completing the Community Center.

As a lover of animals, it broke my heart to see my bunnies and ostriches go un-pet. And that just won't do. I had to provide enrichment. I had to provide the Auto-Petter.

It seems like the rest of the tools/items/craftables have reasonable ways of being acquired, but unless you go the Joja route, the Auto-Petter is soft-locked behind random drops in the Skull Caverns. And personally? Not only is mining one of my least favorite Stardew activities, I am also an avid hater of RNG.

I've created this mod to remove this friction from my gameplay. After placing down my fourth animal building, I've had enough. As the billionaire of Pelican Town, I'm making Marnie offer it in her store, just like she already offers the rest of the animal-related tools. And just as I can't craft any of those, the Auto-Petter follows suit and will not be a craftable item either.

Similar mods exist, but some of them rely on the deprecated Shop Tile Framework mod, so I thought I'd keep mine more up-to-date.

Please, enjoy!





[/b]
